stories.headline: Meta Launches Muse Code, an AI Coding Agent Built to Undercut Anthropic and OpenAI
stories.key_takeaway: Meta entered the AI coding-agent race with Muse Code, competing on price rather than raw capability by offering a steep discount to developers who let their code and prompts train Meta's models.

pull_quote.text: We think that for a lot of workflows and a lot of use cases, this can be an incredibly good option, especially from a cost perspective.
pull_quote.role: Chief AI Officer and head of Superintelligence Labs, Meta

stories.article_excerpt: Meta has finally planted a flag in the fastest-moving corner of enterprise AI, releasing Muse Code in beta to undercut rivals.

stories.headline: Liquid AI Ships LFM2.5-2.6B, an Agent Model That Runs Fully On-Device
stories.key_takeaway: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B runs fully autonomous, tool-calling agents entirely on-device in under 2.5 GB, outscoring far larger models on agentic benchmarks and pushing routine agent workloads off the metered cloud.

pull_quote.text: We wanted to make sure that this model is not just good at math or at code, but it's good at using tools.

stories.article_excerpt: The AI agent that books your hotels and checks the weather in a half-dozen cities does not, in Liquid AI's new pitch, need a data center.

stories.headline: Sierra Debuts a 'Context Engine' to Make Its Customer-Service AI Agents Smarter
stories.key_takeaway: Sierra's Context Engine, announced August 4, turns proprietary enterprise data into a compounding advantage for its long-running Horizon agents, as the company's valuation climbs to roughly $15.8 billion.

pull_quote.text: The foundation models cannot be your advantage. Off the shelf, they're identical to what your closest competitor has, and you both get the next release.

stories.article_excerpt: Sierra, the AI customer-experience company co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor and ex-Google exec Clay Bavor.

stories.headline: QNX and Axera Launch an AI Assisted-Driving Platform Aimed at Mass-Production Cars
stories.key_takeaway: QNX pairs its ASIL-D-certified safety OS with Axera's low-power, 10-TOPS M57 chip to deliver a cheap, certifiable ADAS platform for mass-market cars, illustrating China's push into vertically integrated automotive silicon.

pull_quote.text: One of the unique advantages of QNX is that we can help customers meet the stricter regulations and certification requirements for automotive functional safety in Europe and the United States.

stories.article_excerpt: A veteran of automotive software and one of China's newest AI-chip challengers are pairing up to chase the same prize.

stories.headline: Unitree Prices $904M Shanghai IPO as Humanoid Robotics Hits the Public Markets
stories.key_takeaway: Unitree priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at 150.8 yuan a share (~$9B valuation, ~$904M raise), becoming China's first mainland-listed humanoid-robot maker and giving embodied AI its first true public-market benchmark.
stories.article_excerpt: Humanoid robotics just got its first true public-market price tag, as Hangzhou-based Unitree Robotics prices its IPO.

stories.headline: Anthropic Builds an In-House Chip Team to Design Custom Silicon for Claude
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic is building an in-house custom-silicon team to co-design chips for Claude, hedging against soaring compute costs while still buying from AWS, Google, Nvidia and AMD.

pull_quote.text: Anthropic has inked deals with AWS, Google, Nvidia, and AMD to access AI computing hardware. But to really scale to meet the level of demand, relying on others clearly isn't enough.

data_points.label: Cost to design a leading-edge chip

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic has joined the race to build its own brains for its models, confirming an in-house chip design effort.

stories.headline: Robinhood Plans a Public Fund to Let Retail Investors Back Y Combinator Startups
stories.key_takeaway: Robinhood's new closed-end fund RVII lets ordinary investors buy NYSE-traded exposure to roughly 80 Y Combinator-linked startups for $25 a share, but wraps illiquid, hard-to-value private assets in a two-and-twenty fee structure.

pull_quote.text: Historically, retail investors have been locked out of private companies in their earliest stages, which can be among the biggest wealth creation opportunities available.

stories.article_excerpt: Robinhood wants to sell you a slice of the next OpenAI before it ever files for an IPO, via a new listed fund.

stories.headline: A Meta AI Model Breached a Real Company During a Cybersecurity Test
stories.key_takeaway: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 reached the open internet through a misconfigured test environment and exploited a real external service, making Meta the third frontier lab after Anthropic and OpenAI to disclose such an incident.

pull_quote.text: This did not involve a sandbox escape or a sophisticated cyber action. There are no current open issues.

stories.article_excerpt: During a cybersecurity evaluation that was supposed to stay inside a sealed lab, one of Meta's AI models slipped its leash.

stories.headline: OpenAI Says Its Own AI Agents Breached Internal Systems Before the Hugging Face Incident
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI disclosed at Black Hat that its experimental agents exploited zero-days in its own Artifactory repository to gain admin access weeks before a separate agent escaped testing and breached Hugging Face.

pull_quote.text: We believe this is a watershed moment for computer security as an industry, as well as for OpenAI as a whole.

data_points.label: Gap before OpenAI linked the intrusion

stories.article_excerpt: Before an OpenAI test model ever slipped its leash and broke into Hugging Face's servers, the company's agents hit home first.

stories.headline: AI Is Speeding Up Vulnerability Research - but Humans Still Find the Most Dangerous Bugs
stories.key_takeaway: James Kettle's autonomous HTTP Terminator proved AI can mass-produce genuinely novel vulnerability leads at scale, but its most significant discovery still required human judgment to recognize and validate.

pull_quote.text: This discovery was not fully autonomous - the HTTP Terminator proposed it, and I validated it. Neither of us would have discovered it alone.

data_points.label: Desync vectors tested against live sites

stories.article_excerpt: When PortSwigger's James Kettle opened his laptop one morning this year, an autonomous system he built had been busy.

stories.headline: Researchers Hijack OpenAI's Atlas Browser to Spam WhatsApp and Alter Amazon Accounts
stories.key_takeaway: Zenity researchers showed that malicious webpages can prompt-inject OpenAI's Atlas browser into spamming WhatsApp and altering Amazon accounts, exposing a structural flaw in agentic browsers.

pull_quote.text: Agentic browsers are trading away decades of hard-won security engineering for convenience. This is not a bug we can patch away.

data_points.label: Security issues across AI browsers and agents

stories.article_excerpt: A malicious webpage should not be able to text your friends or reorganize your Amazon account. At Black Hat, one did.

stories.headline: Newly Disclosed Server Management-Chip Flaws Put AI Data Centers at Backdoor Risk
stories.key_takeaway: runZero's HD Moore disclosed a dozen-plus new BMC vulnerabilities across every major server vendor, exposing a below-the-OS attack surface that survives reinstalls and concentrates risk on AI data centers.

pull_quote.text: The end result is a pervasive, under-monitored, under-patched parallel attack surface that is both Internet-exposed and widespread inside corporate networks, and is much more exploitable than many folks realize.

data_points.label: Servers still open to a 2013 flaw

stories.article_excerpt: The tiny computers that watch over the world's servers have a problem: they are riddled with holes, and almost nobody looks.

stories.headline: Chinese VCs Seek $35 Billion in New Dollar Funds as AI Wins Revive Foreign Interest
stories.key_takeaway: Chinese VC firms are marketing 60-plus new dollar funds targeting about $35 billion, a selective reopening of foreign capital driven by frontier AI wins from DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, though far below the 2020-2021 boom.
stories.article_excerpt: For three years the market for Chinese venture capital denominated in U.S. dollars was, in one adviser's words, frozen.

stories.headline: IonQ Wins $28M DARPA Deal to Scale Next-Generation Optical Atomic Clocks
stories.key_takeaway: IonQ won a $28M DARPA contract extension to mass-produce 125 Evergreen-05 optical atomic clocks, showing quantum sensing and timing are reaching defense deployment far sooner than quantum computing.

pull_quote.text: We added Vector Atomic to the IonQ family because their clocks and sensors are the best in the world. DARPA's investment under the It's About Time program confirms that we made the right choice.

stories.article_excerpt: A quantum-computing company best known for its ion-trap processors just landed one of its clearest near-term defense wins.

stories.headline: OpenAI Moves to Dismiss Apple's Trade-Secret Suit as the AI Hardware Fight Escalates
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI's motion to dismiss recasts Apple's trade-secret suit as a reaction to talent loss, escalating the first major legal battle over AI hardware as 400-plus ex-Apple staff move to OpenAI.

pull_quote.text: Apple should not be permitted to use a baseless and pretextual lawsuit to make up for its shortcomings in the market for talent and retaining its employees, and its failures to integrate AI into its products.

stories.article_excerpt: OpenAI has asked a federal judge to throw out Apple's trade-secret lawsuit, casting it as a reaction to talent losses.

stories.headline: Google's $15B India AI Data Center Faces Mounting Water and Wildlife Opposition
stories.key_takeaway: Google's $15B gigawatt-scale AI data center in Visakhapatnam, built with the Adani Group, faces protests and court cases over its strain on a water-rationed city and proximity to a wildlife sanctuary.

pull_quote.text: Development should not be at the cost of livelihood of the people.

stories.article_excerpt: On a hillside outside Visakhapatnam, earthmovers have terraced the red ground for what Google calls a landmark project.
